# EXP-007 model registry (generated by `src/model_registry.py`)

Every trained model: its name, the exact configuration it was trained with, and its results.
All runs: 15 epochs, cosine LR decay, mixed precision, best epoch kept by validation AUC, decision thresholds set on validation (5 % false alarms).
Files for run `NAME`: weights `outputs/exp007/NAME/best.pt`, config `outputs/exp007/NAME/config.json`, results `outputs/exp007/NAME/metrics.json`, per-sample predictions `outputs/exp007/NAME/predictions.csv`, TensorBoard `outputs/tensorboard/NAME`, training log `outputs/exp007/logs/NAME.log`.

**Naming:** `sd_` = siamese_diff, `ef_` = early_fusion, `dino_` = dino_frozen, `norvia_` = NORVIA-only data; `_s1`/`_s2` = seed 1/2; `_more` = + extra data; `_bin` = yes/no loss only; `depth1/3` = encoder depth; `_448`/`_896` = input width; `exp012_raw` = EXP-012 (un-straightened input).

**Final model: `e14_consistent`** (EXP-014, consistent data). Previous best: `sd_depth1_more`.
